title: Security and Detectability Analysis of Unicode Text Watermarking Methods against Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.13325v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Securing digital text is becoming increasingly relevant due to the widespread use of large language models. Individuals' fear of losing control over data when it is being used to train such machine learning models or when distinguishing model-generated output from text written by humans. Digital watermarking provides additional protection by embedding an invisible watermark within the data that requires protection. However, little work has been taken to analyze and verify if existing digital text watermarking methods are secure and undetectable by large language models. In this paper, we investigate the security-related area of watermarking and machine learning models for text data. In a controlled testbed of three experiments, ten existing Unicode text watermarking methods were implemented and analyzed across six large language models: GPT-5, GPT-4o, Teuken 7B, Llama 3.3, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. translated_title: Unicode文本水印方法对抗大型语言模型的安全性与可检测性分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.13325v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：由于大型语言模型的广泛使用，保护数字文本正变得越来越重要。个人担心数据在用于训练此类机器学习模型时失去控制，或难以区分模型生成的输出与人类撰写的文本。数字水印通过在需要保护的数据中嵌入不可见水印来提供额外保护。然而，很少有工作分析和验证现有的数字文本水印方法是否安全且无法被大型语言模型检测。在本文中，我们研究了文本数据水印和机器学习模型的安全相关领域。在一个受控的三项实验测试平台中，实现了十种现有的Unicode文本水印方法，并跨六种大型语言模型进行分析：GPT-5、GPT-4o、Teuken 7B、Llama 3.3、Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro。我们的发现...
tldr: 本文首次系统评估了十种Unicode文本水印方法在六种大型语言模型下的安全性和可检测性，揭示现有水印技术易被高级模型识别或破坏的弱点。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates ten Unicode text watermarking methods across six LLMs for the first time, revealing that existing watermarking techniques are vulnerable to detection or disruption by advanced models.
